current.text: The Knicks brought in Drummond to replace Mitchell Robinson as their backup center.
He is expected to play roughly the backup center minutes Robinson played, behind starter Towns. Little double-big lineup use is expected.
He can play around 29 minutes if Towns misses time.
The Knicks brought in James Wiseman, Drew Eubanks and other camp signings for the big man depth behind him. One or two of them are expected to make the roster.
The Knicks are expected to be cautious over the first 30 or so games, with starters' minutes trimmed and more rest on back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is still an elite offensive rebounder, a good defensive playmaker and a good screener.
He is older now and can no longer do some of the things he once did.

note: Drummond is no draft target for us. Yahoo ranks him 211 and ESPN 251, both sites value him at 0 USD, and his projected line is about 6 points and 8 rebounds in 19 minutes. That is well outside the 144 players we draft. His value is as a handcuff to Towns: if Towns misses time, the backup center role could grow to around 29 minutes, so watch Towns' health and the Knicks' early-season minutes caution. Also check whether Wiseman or Eubanks take any of the backup minutes.
